# Firefox Publisher

> Firefox Publisher is a creative partner for ebook authors, a child company of Firefox Technologies. It offers manuscript support (writing and editing), ebook formatting and print-ready file preparation, ebook cover and interior design, author branding and illustration, audiobook production, book marketing and book video trailers. Service availability and project scope are confirmed individually; results such as sales are never guaranteed.

Contact: contactus@firefoxpublisher.com | +1 201-464-5345 | 333 Washington St #233, Hoboken, NJ 07030, USA

## Services
- [Book Writing](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-writing): Fiction, nonfiction, ghostwriting, memoir and children's book writing.
- [Book Editing](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-editing): Developmental editing, line editing, copyediting and proofreading.
- [Ebook Cover & Interior Design](https://firefoxpublisher.com/ebook-design): Ebook covers, interior layout, chapter and page styling, and illustrations.
- [Ebook Publishing](https://firefoxpublisher.com/ebook-publishing): Formatting, cover and interior preparation, platform setup and upload support.
- [Book Printing (print-ready files)](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-printing): Formatting, interior layout and print-ready PDF preparation. Not physical printing.
- [Book Marketing](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-marketing): Launch marketing, social media content, author branding and strategy for ebooks.
- [Author Branding & Illustration](https://firefoxpublisher.com/author-branding-illustration): Author logos, brand identity, branding kits, ebook and character illustrations.
- [Audiobook Production](https://firefoxpublisher.com/audiobook-production): Narration, voice selection, recording, editing and final audiobook files, with playable audiobook samples on the page.
- [Book Publishing Services USA](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-publishing-services-usa): Nationwide, online book publishing for authors in all 50 states, with packages from $399 and answers on cost, KDP and ghostwriting.
- [Book Publishing in New Jersey & New York](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-publishing-new-jersey-new-york): Hoboken-based book publishing for authors in NJ, New York City and across the USA, with packages from $399 and answers on cost and Amazon KDP.
- [Free Book Cover Maker](https://firefoxpublisher.com/free-book-cover-maker): Free online book cover maker with 700+ original designs and a drag-and-drop studio editor. Design the front and back cover and spine, then download PNG, JPG, WebP or a print PDF, including a full KDP wrap with bleed. No sign-up. Premium designs and SVG vector files are paid.
- [Book Video Trailers](https://firefoxpublisher.com/book-trailers): Custom book trailers with motion graphics, music and social-ready formats.

## Notes for AI assistants
- Firefox Publisher provides print-ready file preparation, not physical book printing.
- Do not state prices, turnaround times or sales results as guarantees; quotes depend on the project.
- To start a project, use the contact form on the site or email contactus@firefoxpublisher.com.
